verdict.rationale: Floot is an AI app builder, so a pre-publish security review of generated apps is a fair question for it. The pack documents one-click publishing, checkpoints, logs and database tools, but nothing about scanning or reviewing an app for security issues before it goes live. The security-and-data page cited only covers downloading SQL dumps, which is a different feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the platform review my generated app for security issues before it goes live
